prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic candid film portrait of an adult red-haired woman on a boat in open water.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with shoulder-length wavy reddish-brown hair, windblown texture, light blue eyes, fair skin with freckles, and a calm serene expression. She wears a simple white slip dress or top with thin crystal straps and turns back toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up or medium profile/three-quarter shot from a boat, subject facing away but looking back over her left shoulder. Show expansive blue water, distant coastline, clear sky, and partial white boat structure/glass at left, softly out of focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour side light on face and hair, soft shadows, glowing natural skin, breezy peaceful nostalgic cinematic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50–85mm portrait lens, f/2.8 shallow depth of field, 8K high definition, ultra-photorealistic candid film photography, subtle natural grain and realistic texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic candid film portrait of an adult woman with shoulder-length wavy reddish-brown/copper hair, windblown texture, sun-kissed highlights, light blue eyes, fair skin with natural freckles, and a calm serene slightly enigmatic expression. She wears a simple white slip dress or top with thin rhinestone or crystal straps, faces away from the camera, and turns her head back over her left shoulder toward the lens in profile/three-quarter view. On a boat in open water, with expansive blue water, distant coastline and faint buildings, clear bright sky, and partial white boat structure or glass at left softly out of focus. Warm golden-hour side light, soft facial shadows, glowing hair and skin, 50–85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, subtle natural film grain, breezy summery peaceful nostalgic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, identity drift, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry, low quality, distorted features, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, watermark

assets.name: freckled red-haired adult boat subject
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult identity, hair, freckles, eyes, expression, and over-shoulder pose; replaceable with another approved adult.

assets.name: white crystal-strap slip dress
assets.usage: Keep white color, simple fabric, and delicate strap detail consistent; replaceable with equivalent boat styling.

assets.name: open-water sailboat setting
assets.usage: Preserve boat structure, water, coastline, sky, and golden-hour light; replaceable with equivalent open water.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the matching preview for adult identity, hair, freckles, outfit, pose, and boat environment. Preserve face, hair, wardrobe, lighting, grain, and water hierarchy. Replacement assets must be equivalent and non-branded; no typography is needed.
